all_takes: NONE of the 15 was used to fit the diode-drop law (TOM_DROP_*), which was fitted on 808 From Mars (docs/tom-pitch-drop-law.json)
NONE has been through a phase-aware drop estimator; no E or tau has been read from any of them before this file
EVERY ONE has had its gate pitch_shape ratio against the shipped engine read and published in #558 -- a pitch-trajectory distance, i.e. diagnostic exposure to the very question asked here
prior_exposure.this_estimator: chosen and its constants frozen on closed-form tones and scipy resonators only (knownanswer.json, controls.json in this directory); our own renders were measured while building it (that is the shipped side, not the corpus)

split_rule: development = every take previously used for SELECTION (#558 development) or DIAGNOSIS (the TUNING 5.0 takes): LT25 LT50 LT75 MT50 HT25 HT50 HT75. confirmation = the 8 takes never used to select or fit anything: LT00 LT10 MT00 MT25 MT75 MT10 HT00 HT10. They are RESERVED for this question, not untouched: see adequacy.

adequacy.independent_confirmation: REFUSED: the corpus holds one take per TUNING setting from one unit, and every reserved take's gate pitch_shape against the shipped engine was read and published in #558. No fresh tom take exists in it, so a confirmation here is on RESERVED, PREVIOUSLY EXPOSED conditions and is never reported as 'untouched' or 'independent'.
adequacy.scope: one TR-808 unit; the 15 Fischer tom takes at TUNING 0/2.5/5/7.5/10; their accent (undocumented) against our accent 1.0. No accent generalisation and no accent-threshold claim. No claim about any other unit or recording.
adequacy.accent_confound: the shipped law's E is linear in (accent - 0.67) and its tau is accent-independent, while 808 From Mars measured tau 13 / 24.5 / 33 ms by accent. A MAGNITUDE discrepancy at an undocumented accent is therefore not identifiable as a law defect: any E from 0 to ~0.24 at pot centre is reachable by SOME accent. Decided now: a confirmed magnitude discrepancy is reported as a measured effect with decision 'not identifiable (accent confound)', never as a justified repair of TOM_DROP_RATIO. The per-sound E ratio across TUNING (accent-invariant under the law's form, if one accent was used for all takes of a sound) is reported DESCRIPTIVELY only.

engine.ours: run_case.render_drum_solo's render (kit_with_sounds + hit_writes, accent 1.0) with TUNING moved: f0 x r, Q x r; at r = 1.0 it must equal render_drum_solo bit-exactly or the run REFUSES
engine.tuning_ratio: r = the take's f_inf / the same sound's TUNING 5.0 take's f_inf, both from this estimator (route A); r = 1 for the 50 take. The law reads the retuned f0 out of the image, as the production host does.
engine.staircase: the PRODUCTION host's (fpga/spi_host.MusicHost) tom-bend writes for the first hit on a fresh image must equal hit_writes' (else REFUSED); decoded through poles_from_regs; a tone with exactly that instantaneous frequency is measured by the same estimator. The render must carry it, route by route, within AGREE_E_ABS + 2 se and AGREE_LN_TAU (else the row is REFUSED: staircase-carry).
engine.598: #598 (repeated hits feeding the bend's endpoint back into nominal tuning) is unresolved. Every render here is ONE hit from a fresh image, so its contamination cannot enter; the staircase's endpoint f0 (1 + E e^-3) != f0 is measured as part of the shipped trajectory (f_inf is free in the fit).
engine.horizon: TOM_DROP_MS = 60 ms is the SCHEDULING HORIZON; the continuous law's tau is 20 ms, and the realised staircase is measured, not assumed.

estimator.model: f(t) = f_inf (1 + E exp(-t / tau)) for t >= T_START after the onset; phase curvature, with the onset phase free (route A: a linear coefficient; route B: the intercept)
estimator.routes: A: unfiltered samples box-car decimated, variable-projection NLS with H1..H3 locked to theta(t). B: order-2 Butterworth low-pass at LP_B fc, interpolated zero crossings, half-cycle count fitted linearly in (a, f_inf, c, zig-zag x2) on a tau grid.
estimator.classes: DROP (E and tau identified), NO-DROP (|E| < max(DETECT_SIGMA se, E_MIN_DETECT): tau not identifiable, not reported), REFUSED(reason): non-finite, silent, sample-rate, too-short, malformed, fit-failed, tau-at-bound, relaxation-unobservable, tau-unidentifiable, route-disagreement; corpus: missing-take, unregistered-take, wrong-hash; engine: not-shipped-engine, host-staircase-mismatch, staircase-carry, no-tuning-reference
estimator.uncertainty: u_E = sqrt(se_E^2 + U_E_FLOOR^2); u_ln_tau = sqrt((se_tau/tau)^2 + U_LN_TAU_FLOOR^2). The floors are the worst error on the harsh analytic family (252 reads), measured before any corpus read.
estimator.known_answer_record: knownanswer.json: 195 / 195 within the frozen bounds (14 correct refusals outside the observable domain); controls.json: 7 / 7 injections CAUGHT, MOVED/BLIND matrix
estimator.known_blind_spot: a second partial 3 % below at -10 dB masks a real E 0.06 drop as NO-DROP (test_known_blind_spot_a_close_partial_can_mask_a_drop)

rules.tau_threshold_note: declared, not perceptual: a 25 % relaxation difference is the smallest this record calls a discrepancy
rules.fit: development rows only: median over MEASURED rows of d_cents = cents0_808 - cents0_ours and of ln(tau_808 / tau_ours) (rows where both are DROP). Fewer than min_dev_rows -> not identifiable. |median d_cents| < jnd -> 'no change' proposed; |median ln tau ratio| < ln 1.25 -> 'no change'.
rules.confirm: ONCE, on the reserved rows, with the fit record frozen (its sha256 is recorded): for a proposed change, CONFIRMED iff >= 75 % of usable rows have the dev sign, >= 75 % are resolved beyond 2u, |median| >= threshold with the dev sign, and the dev median offset predicts the 808 better than the shipped law on >= 75 %. For 'no change', CONFIRMED iff >= 75 % lie within max(threshold, 2u). Fewer than min_confirm_rows usable -> REFUSED (not identifiable). A confirmation set containing any development row is REFUSED.

decision.magnitude: CONFIRMED discrepancy -> 'not identifiable (accent confound)' per adequacy.accent_confound; CONFIRMED no-change -> no repair; NOT-CONFIRMED -> unsupported; REFUSED -> not identifiable
decision.relaxation: CONFIRMED discrepancy -> repair supported for the relaxation time on reserved (previously exposed) conditions at this unit's undocumented accent; NOT-CONFIRMED -> unsupported; REFUSED -> not identifiable
decision.never: no RTL, image or decoded-output delivery claim; any repair is a separate, reviewed change that must prove link, RTL and decoded-output carry-through
